title: Automated license classifier + ND/NC routing
context: Scaling the corpus needs an automated license classifier that sorts each article into the fixed PMC OA license bucket and routes ND/closed to metadata-only. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. The classifier never upgrades a bucket automatically; borderline cases default conservative and go to human review.
objective: Build the automated license classifier that buckets each article and routes ND/NC per gate-004.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifies each article into the fixed PMC OA license bucket from its machine-readable license; routes ND/closed to metadata-only and CC0/BY/SA/NC to full text per gate-004.
Validated against a hand-labeled sample (>= 50 articles); reports accuracy; any disagreement defaults to the more conservative bucket (metadata-only) pending human review.
Never upgrades a license bucket automatically; a human reviewer confirms borderline cases.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; no credentials committed.
